claims.evidence: Witness observed mudguards, front/rear suspension, and disc brakes.
Age cannot be determined from visual inspection alone.
Witness noted gear shifting and brake responsiveness were not shown.
Witness noted hidden rust was not shown.
Originality of components cannot be confirmed without technical specifications or receipts.

risks.risk: Mechanical failure of the gear shifting system.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike shifting smoothly through all gears while the pedals are turning.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a full derailleur and shifter replacement.

risks.risk: Structural failure or seizing of the folding hinge.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being folded and unfolded, and a close-up of the locking mechanism.
risks.if_unproven: As a damaged frame with limited utility.

risks.risk: Ineffective braking or worn-out disc pads/rotors.
risks.proof: A video of the wheels spinning and coming to an immediate stop when brakes are applied.
risks.if_unproven: As needing a complete brake system overhaul.

risks.risk: Internal rust or suspension seal failure.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the suspension stanchions and the underside of the frame.
risks.if_unproven: As a rigid frame bike with non-functional suspension.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being folded and unfolded to check hinge integrity.
Video of the gears shifting through the entire range.
Video of the brakes being tested while the wheels are in motion.
Close-up photos of the chain, derailleur, and brake calipers to check for rust and wear.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Magisie folding fat bike. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state until mechanical proof is provided.
